tools.name: list_stems
tools.description: List the workspace's stems (services): type, description, enabled, dependencies, ports, custom scripts, and the live state when the daemon runs. Works without a daemon.

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Live state of each stem: lifecycle state, glyph (healthy/degraded/failed/stopped/...), reason, pid, ports, uptime, restarts, health summary, latest metrics. Secrets are redacted.

stems.description: Only these stems (default: every enabled stem).

tools.name: get_graph
tools.description: The dependency graph: nodes {name, type, status, glyph, reason} and edges {from, to, condition, soft, protocol, via}. Live status when the daemon runs, config only otherwise.

focus.description: Only this stem, its dependencies and its dependants.

profile.description: Only the stems of this profile (with their hard dependencies).

tools.name: start
tools.description: Start stems (and their unstarted hard dependencies unless no_deps) and wait until they are ready. Returns {ok, ready, failed, skipped}.

no_deps.description: Do not start unstarted hard dependencies.

tools.name: stop
tools.description: Stop stems. Running dependants make this fail with HAS_DEPENDANTS unless cascade is true.

timeout_ms.description: Per-stem stop grace override in milliseconds.

tools.name: restart
tools.description: Restart stems keeping their ports; with build, run each stem's build script between stop and start.

stems.description: Stems to restart (allocated ports are kept).

no_deps.description: Do not start unstarted hard dependencies.

build.description: Stop, run each stem's `build` script, then start (deliverable 16).

tools.name: up
tools.description: Bring stems up (a profile, or named stems with their dependencies) and wait until ready; sends progress notifications. fresh is destructive (needs confirm and agent.allow_destructive).

stems.description: Stems to start (their hard dependencies are added); empty = the profile's stems.

profile.description: Profile to bring up when `stems` is empty (default: the workspace's default profile, else every enabled stem).

fresh.description: Destructive: stop the planned stems, run their `reset` scripts and clear their stamps first so `setup`/`seed` run again. Needs `confirm: true` and `agent.allow_destructive`.

confirm.description: Confirms a destructive call (`fresh`), after asking the user.

timeout_ms.description: Overall deadline in milliseconds (default: each stem's start timeout).

tools.name: down
tools.description: Stop stems (default: every running stem). all (also stops the daemon) and volumes (removes docker volumes) are destructive (need confirm and agent.allow_destructive).

stems.description: Stems to stop; empty = every running stem.

all.description: Destructive: stop everything and shut the daemon down. Needs `confirm: true` and `agent.allow_destructive`.

volumes.description: Destructive: also remove the docker volumes of the selected stems. Needs `confirm: true` and `agent.allow_destructive`.

confirm.description: Confirms a destructive call (`all`, `volumes`), after asking the user.

tools.name: run_script
tools.description: Run a stem or workspace script with arguments by name and wait for it: {ok, exit, duration_ms, tail (last output lines), error}. Custom scripts are also published as <stem>__<script> tools.

stem.description: Owning stem; omit for a workspace-level script.

name.description: Script name (see the `<stem>__<script>` tools for custom scripts).

args.description: Arguments by name, validated against the script's declared `args` (`{"email": "a@b.c"}`); invalid ones fail with `SCRIPT_ARGS_INVALID`.

start_deps.description: Start the script's `requires:` stems first if they are not healthy.

tools.name: get_logs
tools.description: Captured log records (oldest first, at most 500 per call) filtered by stems, time, level, regex; paginate with next_cursor. truncated is true when not every matching record is in the result.

since.description: Records at or after this time: a duration before now (`10m`, `1h30m`) or an RFC 3339 instant.

grep.description: Only records whose text matches this regex.

tail.description: Only the last `n` matching records (then paged oldest first).

cursor.description: `next_cursor` of a previous call: continue after it (the other filters are taken from the cursor).

tools.name: get_metrics
tools.description: CPU, memory and process counts per stem (latest sample, optional history), with totals.

stems.description: Only these stems (default: every enabled stem).

history.description: Include the samples of this last period (`5m`, `30s`).

tools.name: get_events
tools.description: The daemon's event log (state changes, scripts, health, watchdogs, ...) with who caused each event (actor), oldest first; filter by kinds and actor, page with since_seq.

since_seq.description: Only events with a greater `seq` (use the previous result's `next_since_seq`); default: every buffered event.

kinds.description: Only these kinds (`stem.state`, or a prefix with `*`: `script.*`).

actor.description: Only events caused by this actor (`mcp:<client>`, `cli:<user>`, `daemon`).

limit.description: Events per call, oldest first (default 100, at most 500).

tools.name: get_config
tools.description: The resolved workspace config (or one stem's), secrets redacted. Works without a daemon.

effective.description: Add the table of defaults applied to unset fields.

tools.name: doctor
tools.description: Check that this machine can run the workspace (tools, ports, Docker, daemon, orphans). fix is destructive (needs confirm and agent.allow_destructive). Works without a daemon.

fix.description: Destructive: apply the safe fixes (stale locks, orphans, ...), then check again. Needs `confirm: true` and `agent.allow_destructive`.

confirm.description: Confirms a destructive call (`fix`), after asking the user.

tools.name: reset
tools.description: Destructive: stop stems, run their reset scripts and clear their stamps (data is lost). Needs confirm and agent.allow_destructive.

stems.description: Stems to reset: stopped, their `reset` scripts run, stamps cleared.

confirm.description: Required (destructive): confirms the call, after asking the user. The workspace must also set `agent.allow_destructive`.

tools.name: watch_pause
tools.description: Pause file watchdogs (all, or some stems').

stems.description: Only these stems; empty = every watchdog (global pause; a global resume also clears every per-stem pause).

tools.name: watch_resume
tools.description: Resume file watchdogs (all, or some stems').

stems.description: Only these stems; empty = every watchdog (global pause; a global resume also clears every per-stem pause).

tools.name: get_health
tools.description: The last health probe results per stem (outcome, latency, detail), failures in a row and recent transitions.

last.description: Probe results per stem, newest last (default 10, at most 50).

tools.name: get_outputs
tools.description: Evaluated stem outputs (URLs, connection strings, ...); secret outputs are always redacted.

stems.description: Only these stems (default: every stem that declares outputs).

tools.name: echo_svc__ping
tools.description: Prints pong (custom script `ping` of stem `echo-svc`; returns the run_script result)
